modified_prior_sources.reason: Carry unique Admission through shared one-shot factory State into Owner and Context; no publication or stop side effects at construction
Own optional stable Admission before Context and expose defaulted constructor/factory source extension
Enter admission after binding lease and before all callback body accesses; release admission before binding lease on success and unwind; preserve LastError

findings.detail: All ten SDK entries share invoke. Optional AdmissionLease is constructed after binding Lease and before lambda body/state/buffer access. Failed enter owns no admission; permanent Errors fails fast rather than returning API success.

Explicit admission.release precedes lease.release on success; reverse unwind order has the same lifetime property. leave is nonthrowing and exactly-once; binding active count remains nonzero throughout leave. Incoming/outgoing LastError and null-admission legacy path are tested.

Controller rejects foreign thread, same-controller callback reentry and stopped entry. Mutex is held only across gate bookkeeping; no body/original/provider/wait executes under it. Unsupported paths are rejected; arbitrary host-thread PTD or general concurrency is not implemented.

Immovable Controller is uniquely owned before Context construction and survives Binding/Context/effect teardown. Shared one-shot factory consumption owns admission once. Nullable legacy/defaulted source extensions preserve source behavior but change source ABI/layout and require full rebuild.

Failed or throwing external proof does not change gate state. A previously stopped gate stays stopped and is never reopened. On selected normal path proof failure precedes stop and leaves admission usable. Successful proof is followed by Controller.stop then B15 native close; active callback stop returns false. Stop itself does not prove hooks disabled, callback quiescence or worker joins.

40 core checks include14 own terminal children:10 stopped native entries with inaccessible body buffers, foreign connect, reentry folderW, exception unwind and wrong leave.33 integration checks assemble actual B4 Runtime+B16 Policy+B14 fake engine and own same-domain memory: exact moved state, typed callbacks, handle lifecycle, timeout, proof throw, failed registration and retry.
